The '''Republic Emergency Response Corps''' was an organization within the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] that dealt with military and political crises during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]] worked closely with the Corps. The Emergency Response Corps was involved in the [[battle for Hammer Station]].<ref name="TOR:IFHS" />
